name: backend-api
description: Runtime-only manifest for the backend container. The shared vite-project/package.json mixes frontend and backend deps in one list, so installing it server-side pulled in React, Vite, TypeScript, ESLint and the whole build toolchain — none of which backend_api/ ever imports. These 15 are exactly what a grep of backend_api/ requires; keep this in sync when adding a backend dependency.
